title: Compute the residue pull mate on flat-resolution complexes
statement: For every scheme map f and integral complex P that is K-flat and is an integer-indexed colimit of bounded-above flat complexes, the reduction counit on f*P is invertible. On H, the homotopy image of P, the composite of the integral pull counit, reduction counit and localized ordinary pullIso equals p_f followed by the reduction and residue pull counits, with all maps as in [new-integral-residue-pull-square-data].

source.place: Lemma 6.5.9(3), Proposition 6.8.11(3), Remark 6.8.15; explicit formal coefficient and adjunction argument

proof.text: Pullback preserves flat modules: the local relation criterion for flatness is preserved by inverse image, and extension along the coefficient pullback isomorphism preserves flatness. Pullback preserves colimits. Hence the given colimit presentation maps to a colimit of bounded-above flat complexes, which is K-flat. The reduction counit on it is invertible.

Transpose the desired equality under derived scalar extension/restriction. The derived unit and counit factorization identities reduce it to the ordinary scalar pull square on P. Check that ordinary pullIso transposes to comapUpperStarIso by the balanced-tensor presentation epimorphism and the action identities. Apply the equation degreewise, pass to homotopy categories, and localize. This gives exactly the equality in the declaration.

proof_origin.note: B2: flat-resolution computation, exact derived-square transport, and proved inverse-mate pasting.

theorem residueExchangePull_flatModel
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (P : CochainComplex
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) Ab.{u + 1})
        (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) Y)) ℤ)
    (hP : (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso _ (.up ℤ)).kFlat P)
    (hcolim : ObjectProperty.flat.cochainComplexMinus.colimitsOfShape ℤ P) :
    let H := (HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj P
    IsIso ((residueExchangeReductionCounit ℓ E X).app
        ((((f)^*⟦integralCoeff ℓ E⟧).mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj H)) ∧
    (residueExchangeReduction ℓ E X).map
        ((residueExchangeUpperStarCounit (integralCoeff ℓ E) f).app H) ≫
      (residueExchangeReductionCounit ℓ E X).app
          ((((f)^*⟦integralCoeff ℓ E⟧).mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj H) ≫
      DerivedCategory.Qh.map
        ((NatTrans.mapHomotopyCategory
          (pullIso (integralReductionMap ℓ E) f).hom (.up ℤ)).app H) =
    (residueExchangePullHom ℓ E f).app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj H) ≫
      (residueExchangeUpperStar
        (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (integralResidue ℓ E)) f).map
          ((residueExchangeReductionCounit ℓ E Y).app H) ≫
      ((residueExchangeUpperStarCounit
        (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (integralResidue ℓ E)) f).app
          (((Mod.extendScalars
            (coefficientMap (integralReductionMap ℓ E) Y)).mapHomotopyCategory
              (.up ℤ)).obj H))
